summary: Publish the v0.2 documentation and version bump

delivery.outcome: Land the v0.2 documentation that GOV-BUDGET-001 cut from ticket-004, and close the resulting drift between contract version 0.2.0 and VERSION 0.1.0.
nonGoals: No contract, Protobuf, checker or stream change; those landed with ticket-004
No projection field map; the SODL/PLOG drift stays recorded as an open risk
No migration tooling for streams written without a hash chain

architecture.decision: Documentation only. ticket-004 raised the contract bundle to 0.2.0 but its five-file budget forced docs/ and VERSION out of the diff, leaving main describing a v0.1 design while shipping a v0.2 contract. This closes that gap with the evidence already gathered, so no new analysis is introduced.
architecture.rollback: Revert the branch. Nothing executable depends on these files.

validation.evidence: LOGS-PASS is unaffected by a documentation-only diff
